name: Harley-Davidson Nightster 975
engine: 975 cc liquid-cooled Revolution Max V-twin, fuel injected, belt drive
intro: The liquid-cooled Sportster. Some early 2022 bikes have a handlebar recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2022 Nightsters built Dec 2021 to Sep 2022 are in recall 22V745 because the handlebar weld can separate.
A-002.reason: A broken handlebar means losing steering. The fix is free.

recalls.what: Handlebar weld may separate between the inner and outer sections.
